title: Xbox White Friday sale: up to 80% off, 19 Nov to 2 Dec (US)
slot: first free slot after 04:05 Dubai Tue 17 Nov

sources.note: Xbox Wire, Joe Skrebels, 16 Nov 2026, read in full by WebFetch: deals 19 Nov (9 PM PST) to 2 Dec; more offers from 23 Nov; up to 80% off select Xbox and PC games, more than 2,000 games on sale; Gears of War: E-Day Premium Edition 30%, Forza Horizon 6 Premium Edition 25%, NBA 2K27 55%, Madden NFL 27 50%, Crimson Desert Enhanced 20%, Halo: Campaign Evolved Premium 20%, Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade 80%, Grounded 2 Founder's Edition 20%, The Blood of Dawnwalker 20%; Design Lab up to 15% off controllers; discounts US only, offers vary by market and retailer; no hardware prices.

first_report: 2026-11-16 23:57Z Xbox Wire (watch digest breaking seq 553); about 5 h old at build; not in earlier digests; Arabic outlets not checked
footage: Official Steam trailers by app id: Forza Horizon 6 Launch Trailer (2483190), Gears of War: E-Day Launch Trailer (3010850), Crimson Desert Enhanced announcement trailer (3321460), Grounded 2 Beat the Heat (2661300); Steam page of Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade has only an ESRB rating clip, so no footage of it; the trailers' own music
sound: trailer own sound, per shot (our bed if the audio split refuses)

angle.hook: Xbox's biggest sale of the year opens 19 Nov with up to 80% off, Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade at 80%
angle.why_now: Xbox Wire announced it 16 Nov; deals start 19 Nov and run to 2 Dec
angle.what_it_means_here: Xbox says the discounts are US only and offers vary by market and retailer, so Gulf prices are not announced
angle.payoff: Gears of War: E-Day 30% and Forza Horizon 6 25% on Premium Editions

gate: gate 01:14Z: Xbox Wire page read in full, no update note; ledger find xbox black friday sale: 0 hits; Nintendo Black Friday story of 14 Nov is a different company
arabic_notes: Black Friday written as الجمعة البيضاء (White Friday) per glossary; Xbox as إكس بوكس

director_check.looked: Look 1: Arabic headline 'خصم يصل إلى 80 بالمئة في عروض إكس بوكس' with السعر chip over close-up game creature art, readable. Look 2: floating-rocks trailer shot, credit 'المصدر: إكس بوكس واير (Xbox Wire)', line 'أعلنت إكس بوكس (Xbox) عروض الجمعة البيضاء في أمريكا', strip 80 بالمئة / 19 نوفمبر إلى 2 ديسمبر / أمريكا فقط. Look 3: dark Gears shot, credit, line 30 بالمئة Gears of War: E-Day and 25 بالمئة Forza Horizon 6, same strip. All text legible, matches story file, no gore.
